forcedExit.title: A forced exit
forcedExit.body: In this teaching episode, the rule closed the leveraged position at its teaching maintenance level.

survivedButHurt.title: The position survived
survivedButHurt.body: Survival does not mean the path was easy. Leverage made the same move affect more virtual money.

userExitedEarly.title: You exited
userExitedEarly.body: An early exit changes the path you experience. It does not make one episode a forecast.

unleveragedSurvived.title: The unleveraged replay stayed open
unleveragedSurvived.body: The same path can affect a position differently when there is no borrowed exposure.

recoveryMaths.title: Recovery maths
recoveryMaths.body: A fifty percent loss needs a one hundred percent gain to return to the starting amount. This is a mathematical example, not a prediction.
